name: Tiny Village Healing Human Farms
description: Tiny Village Healing Farms provides therapeutic farming experiences that promote mental health, community building, and sustainable agriculture practices for healing and growth.

branchDonations.name: Land or Property
branchDonations.short: Space for a healing farm or garden
branchDonations.description: Donate or lease land so we can establish a therapeutic farm where people can come to heal, grow food, and reconnect with the natural world.

branchDonations.name: Farm Animals
branchDonations.description: Donate chickens, goats, rabbits, or other gentle animals that can be cared for as part of therapeutic farm routines and healing programs.

branchDonations.name: Seeds and Seedlings
branchDonations.short: Plants that nourish body and spirit
branchDonations.description: Contribute vegetable seeds, herb starts, and medicinal plant seedlings so our healing gardens stay full, productive, and diverse season to season.

branchDonations.name: Farming Tools
branchDonations.description: Donate hoes, rakes, wheelbarrows, pruners, and other hand tools that make farm work accessible and enjoyable for program participants.

branchDonations.name: Building Materials
branchDonations.short: Materials for tiny structures on the farm
branchDonations.description: Give lumber, roofing, windows, or other salvaged building materials to help us construct small cabins, tool sheds, and sheltered gathering spaces.

branchDonations.name: Therapy Program Sponsorship
branchDonations.short: Support access to healing for those in need
branchDonations.description: Sponsor a participant in our therapeutic farming program — covering their costs so financial hardship is never a barrier to healing and growth.

contentSubHeading: Explore our healing practices and community initiatives

branchFeatures.description: Working with soil, plants, and seasons is one of the oldest forms of therapy known to humanity. Our farm creates structured time outdoors that settles the nervous system and restores hope.
Small, thoughtful dwellings on farmland give our residents a stable, beautiful place to live while they rebuild relationship, rhythm, and purpose.
Weekly gatherings around fermentation crocks, seed-saving, bread baking, and natural building teach practical skills and rebuild the sense that life is worth engaging.
Residents plant, tend, and harvest their own food — experiencing the deep satisfaction of providing for themselves and contributing to the table they share with neighbors.
